description: dispose() in state conflict closes immediately (MCPWARP.md §5.7, §6.8 Take-over close): the name is gone, so there is nothing to unregister or drain. The fake edge holds the connection open; the conflict makes the SDK close it at once (error{NO_ERROR} + WS close 1000), and the disconnect {fatal: false, wsCode: 1000} after the conflict models that take-over close completing (the held edge answering the SDK's own close frame), so an SDK whose dispose() awaits the socket close can resolve. It ends an already-ended generation: no snapshot, no reconnect. The fixture never ticks, so a dispose() that waited on an unregister or a drain grace would stay unresolved at the end: one off at once, then nothing.

expect.lastError: Another connection took over this name.
